subject: Re: Private VPC architecture review & next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC architecture review & next steps

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Acme Health is evaluating a private VPC deployment for PHI workloads, needs audit logs + KMS integration, and would like predictable latency for inference. You mentioned procurement wants an architecture-level session before we share an SOW.

Proposed next step: schedule a 60-minute architecture review (technical deep dive) with your infra team + our solutions engineering and infra leads. Marissa (cc'd) would lead the runbook and Nikhil will join for kernel/quantization questions.

A few things we'll cover:
- high level network/topology options (VPC peering vs PrivateLink)
- KMS/HSM and key lifecycle integration
- audit/logging and retention controls
- capacity planning and SLA expectations
- procurement/ops checklist for on-prem or cloud-hosted private control plane

Can you share 2 windows that work next week? If easier, pick a slot on my calendar: https://calendly.com/aditya-redwood/priv-vpc-review

I attached a short checklist we typically run through — should help your infra team prepare.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood_private_vpc_checklist.pdf (1 page)

Thanks — confirmed for Tue 7 Mar, 10:00–11:00 PT. I'll lead the session and bring the architecture checklist + example network diagrams. Attached is a one-page prep checklist for Lina/Raj so they can gather the right info (subnet ranges, existing KMS provider, audit/logging tool). If possible, please share the VPC CIDR and any firewall/proxy restrictions before the call.

Quick notes:
- For PHI workloads we typically recommend PrivateLink when customers want tighter network isolation; VPC Peering can work but has scaling/route table complexity.
- We'll also review our private control plane options (VPC-hosted vs on-prem control plane).

Attachment: redwood_private_vpc_checklist.pdf
